text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Inquiry into missing Piper Lance aircraft; six men believed to have died when tiny aircraft disappeared on flight from Tunisia to Malta in December 1995.
- Opposition leader Adami and other opposition speakers accuse Prime Minister Sant of going ahead with plans to replace VAT despite advice that new system involving customs and excise is inferior.
- Police asked to investigate allegations of bribery at Planning Authority.
